let rec addAux (l1 l2 : List Nat) (carry : Nat) : List Nat :=
    match l1, l2 with
    | [], [] =>
      if carry = 0 then [] else [carry]
    | h1::t1, [] =>
      let sum := h1 + carry
      (sum % 10) :: addAux t1 [] (sum / 10)
    | [], h2::t2 =>
      let sum := h2 + carry
      (sum % 10) :: addAux [] t2 (sum / 10)
    | h1::t1, h2::t2 =>
      let sum := h1 + h2 + carry
      (sum % 10) :: addAux t1 t2 (sum / 10)
  addAux l1 l2 0
